parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the secondary elastic network interfaces (ENIs) to which the EIP that you want to query is attached. This parameter refers to the network interface controller (NIC) associated with the EIP.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region to which the EIP belongs. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query region IDs.
